title: Tackling resource challenges with expert advice and managed services
outcome: Error-prone manual Excel commission process replaced with managed operations
challenge: Commissions ran on nothing but a manual Excel system — frequent errors, no structured reporting, and no in-house resources to fix it.
whatWeDid: We took over commission operations as a managed service: structured calculation runs, error controls, and standardized reporting.
results: Comp operations covered without new headcount
